introHtml: Faux leather headphones offer a professional look with the durability and comfort needed for daily use. Unlike plastic models, the soft padding and textured finish make them ideal for corporate gifts or trade show giveaways where you want to convey quality. The TerraTone Headphones, for example, feature adjustable headbands and cushioned ear cups that hold up well in bulk orders. Choose custom faux leather headphones to add a sophisticated touch to your brand without the cost of genuine leather.
